description:
Token Supply Lookup: total supply of any ERC-20 on Ethereum mainnet. Total supply of an ERC-20 token contract on Ethereum via totalSupply given token address.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_eth_reads_v1/eth_mainnet_erc20_totalsupply. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
Measured output: {"chain": "ethereum", "method": "totalSupply", "ok": true, "result": "88302633055702652", "service": "x402_eth_reads_v1.eth_mainnet_erc20_totalsupply"}
